newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Labroy Marine in loan, warrants issue.
newsitem.headline: Labroy Marine in loan, warrants issue.

text.p: Shipping company Labroy Marine Ltd said on Wednesday it was proposing a 41-million warrants issue in conjunction with a Singapore $60 million loan facility.
Labroy said in a statement the loan from DBS Bank would not exceed a term of five years.
DBS Bank will offer the warrants to Singapore-registered shareholders on the basis of one warrant for every five existing shares.
The warrants issue will raise net proceeds of about S$59.2 million of which S$9.0 million will be used to finance a floating dock.
Another S$9.0 million will fund long term loans and the remaining S$41.2 million will be used to fund two livestock carriers, one product tanker, two tugs and 10 barges.
